SettingsAppPassword.description: A named password for one calendar, contacts, files or meeting app. The secret itself is never listed.

lastUsedAt.description: Last DAV or Meet Basic sign-in with this password, written at most once per five minutes.

lastUsedClient.description: User-Agent of that sign-in, cut to 120 characters.

appPasswords.description: Active app passwords of the caller, newest first. Revoked ones are not listed.

SettingsAppPasswordCreateRequest.description: Send `code` when the caller has two-factor on (the account password is not accepted then), otherwise `currentPassword`. `GET /me` → `mfa.enabled` says which.

currentPassword.description: The account password, when two-factor is off. An app password is not accepted here. Failures count on the sign-in rate limit.

code.description: A current authenticator code, when two-factor is on. Recovery codes are not accepted. Same checks as `POST /settings/totp/recovery-codes`: replay guard, sign-in rate limit and per-user code lock.

password.description: The new password: 16 lowercase letters. Returned once and never again. Clients show it in groups of four; spaces are ignored when it is used.
